text: “As a mother never gives up on her child, a teacher never gives up on her students.”
text_2: At Ananya Tots, we don’t just hire teachers. We welcome educators who want to join a community that believes in children, in learning and in one another. Come grow with us. Come inspire young minds.
text_3: “The first five years have so much to do with how the next 80 turn out.” – Bill Gates
